fields.title: Honeycomb continuum completion
fields.issue: Only normalE and transverseGL/GW are sourced. InplaneE=.01MPa,G=.005MPa and zero core Poisson couplings are explicit regularizations. Actual cells, cell-scale dimpling, defects, adhesive, seams and debonding are absent. Increasing inplaneE/G100-fold to1/.5MPa changes accepted W linear eigenpressures by about0.0001% for021 and0.003% for021b; this limited sensitivity does not source the properties.
